description: This Java class defines the main entry point for the Connectivity service in the Eclipse Ditto project. It initializes the service, reads configuration, and sets up the Akka actor system with a root actor.

classes.name: ConnectivityService
classes.description: Entry point class for the Connectivity service, extends DittoService to provide startup and configuration logic.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Static method to start the Connectivity service by creating an instance and waiting for it to terminate.

methods.name: getServiceSpecificConfig
methods.description: Returns the service-specific configuration by transforming the general config.

methods.name: getMainRootActorProps
methods.description: Creates Props for the main root actor with the given configuration and mediator.
